item.description: Patch 7.21 takes to the stars with Cosmic Exploration: large-scale gameplay for Disciples of the Hand and Land, and brand-new tool enhancement with Cosmic Tools. Join hands with the Loporrits and work to discover the wonders of distant stars! * Additional features will be implemented in future updates: Mamool Ja Allied Society Quests, the Occult Crescent, Weapon Enhancement Quests - Phantom Weapons, and Inconceivably Further Hildibrand Adventures sidequests are scheduled to release in Patch 7.25. Read the patch notes.

item.title: Join us for Duty Commenced on April 23!
item.description: The next episode of Duty Commenced, the North American Community team's live show, is set for Wednesday, April 23. Join the Community team as they check out the Hatching-tide seasonal event and challenge opponents from the AAC Cruiserweight tier! As always, there will be a showcase of the latest entries for Community Commendations and giveaways! Read on for details.

item.title: Announcing the Furnishing Design Contest 2025
item.description: Have you stumbled upon an idea when putting your decor together and thought how much you would like to have a certain piece to make the ensemble all perfect? Now is your chance to make that dream a reality with the FFXIV Furnishing Design Contest! In this contest, entries are not judged strictly on appearance, but by the heart and soul of each design. If you have an idea for a new furnishing item that expresses your hunger for housing, your desire for decoration, and your adoration for Eorzea and all the lands of FINAL FANTASY XIV, put your pen to paper and let your passion shine! Whether it be a complementary piece to some of your favorite existing furnishings, or simply items of an aesthetic you love, we can't wait to see your brilliant creations. However! This time, we also have our artisans of light from China and Korea participating in a similar contest. To make this a grand event, when we announce the winners, we'll showcase their entries as well, so look forward to seeing many, many, amazing furnishing designs! Read on for details.

item.title: Patch 7.2─Seekers of Eternity Special Site Updated!
item.description: The Patch 7.2 special site has been updated with screenshots of the mounts and gear featured in Cosmic Exploration, coming in Patch 7.21. This update also includes new CG art of the bosses from the Arcadion: Cruiserweight Division and Recollection. View the special site.

New Optional Items & Limited-time Sale!
item.description: New optional items will be added to the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store starting Wednesday, April 16 around 1:00 a.m. (PDT). We're also hosting a Hatching-tide sale for a limited time, so don't miss out on some eggsclusive deals! Visit the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store. * The items featured above will be available for purchase after the scheduled maintenance ends on Wednesday, April 16 around 1:00 a.m. (PDT). Please visit the News section for detailed maintenance information. * Please note that there may be a delay in the delivery of items directly after sales commence due to congestion of the delivery system.

item.description: Get ready for The Unending Journey's next episode on Thursday, April 17! Join the EU Community team as we tackle some brand-new challenges! This time, we'll be making our way through the cruiserweight tier of the Arcadion, before crossing blades with the Queen's Knight in Recollection (Extreme). Put on your best glamour and join us for some screenshots at the Solution Nine Aetheryte Plaza on Ragnarok (Chaos DC)! Read on for details.

item.title: Invite Friends Back with the Callback Campaign!
item.description: Calling all erstwhile adventurers! With the Callback Campaign, you can invite back friends and free company members who are taking a break. Meet the campaign requirements, and both you and your invitees will receive special rewards! Furthermore, returning adventurers can qualify for up to seven days of free play time! Don’t miss this special opportunity to reintroduce the wonders of FFXIV to your friends and comrades!

item.title: Immerse Gamepack FINAL FANTASY XIV Edition on Sale for a Limited Time!
item.description: Immerse Gamepack FINAL FANTASY XIV Edition, an add-on for FFXIV (Windows version) jointly tuned by the Sound team and Embody, is available for 30% off in commemoration of the release of Patch 7.2─Seekers of Eternity! item.title: Crystalline Conflict Community Cup 2025 (North America) Streaming Details & Brackets
item.description: Get ready for some exciting bouts in the upcoming North American Crystalline Conflict Community Cup for 2025! We're pleased to announce the teams filling up the preliminary brackets to show their mettle in the ring as they attempt to claim one of the top spots for glory!  Teams who move forward to the Quarterfinals and onwards will have their matches showcased live starting on Friday, April 18! Click here for more details.

item.title: Pre-order the FFXIV TTRPG Scenario & Gamemaster Guide!
item.description: Our latest addition to the FFXIV TTRPG lineup, the Scenario & Gamemaster Guide, is now available for pre-order! The Scenario & Gamemaster Guide is an extensive supplement to the Starter Set and Standard Rulebook. The guide contains game data and lore on monsters, optional rules to help take your adventures to the next level, as well as helpful tips for gamemasters to customize or write scenarios of their own!

item.title: Patch 7.2 Notes
item.description: We are proud to present the patch notes for Seekers of Eternity, which follows the Warrior of Light's encounter with the returned Queen of Reason as Alexandria descends into unrest, and features the new trial, Recollection, along with the new raid dungeon, the Arcadion: Cruiserweight Division. The patch also sees the reintroduction of the Borderland Ruins (Secure) for Frontline, updates to group pose depth of field effects, and a host of other additions and adjustments. * Additional features will be implemented in future updates: Cosmic Exploration and Tool Enhancement Quests - Cosmic Tools are scheduled to release in Patch 7.21. Mamool Ja Allied Society Quests, the Occult Crescent, Weapon Enhancement Quests - Phantom Weapons, Inconceivably Further Hildibrand Adventures sidequests are scheduled to release in Patch 7.25.Read the patch notes.

item.title: All You Gotta Do Is Just Meet Me at PAX Aus 2024
item.description:
Lali-ho! Kiwikopo here, reporting in with stories from the team's adventures in the wonderful land of Oz--I mean Australia--this year.
We attended both Melbourne International Games Week and PAX Australia in early October, and for the first time in a decade, a few members of the Development team also flew over from Japan to join us in celebrating FFXIV in the land Down Under.

item.title: You Think I'm Going to Fall for an Illusion?!

Hello everyone, this is Pumpkin Spicycre from the Community team!

Hello, everyone! 
Ali here from the FFXIV Marketing team! I'm so excited to be back with another recap, this time for PAX West 2024! I'm also thrilled to be joined by Francis from the Marketing team and Minaryne from the Community team who will help me paint the picture of PAX West as beautifully as any pictomancer...

item.title: An Anniversary Rising
item.description:
Ohokaliy! It's Kiwikopo from the Community team~ 
Have you been enjoying the Moonfire Faire? If you have yet to partake in the summery festivities, you'll have until Monday, August 26 at 7:59 a.m. (PDT) to complete the event quest and receive the Uchiwasshoi emote. Don't forget to give the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course a go as well, I promise the view is worth it!

item.title: "Give it All" in the Arcadion!
item.description:
Hello, Warriors of Light!   I'm Francis from the Marketing team, and like many of you I have been enraptured by "Give it All," the song that plays during the battle against Wicked Thunder in the Arcadion. 
The song's vocals were performed by Chrissy Costanza, lead vocalist for the popular rock band Against the Current, who worked in close collaboration with Masayoshi Soken and THE PRIMALS. Chrissy was amazing to work with and her distinct rock vocals really turn up the energy and electrify the atmosphere during battle!
